course.title: Philosophy degree | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: You can choose to study Philosophy through Honours Arts or Honours Arts and Business .

reg.title: Regular system of study | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: In the regular system of study, you'll be in school between September and April each year and have your summers free to work, travel, and pursue your interests outside of school.
Finish your degree in four years, instead of five years as in co-op.

uk.title: Honours Arts (includes 28 majors) admission requirements for British System (A Levels) high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: Three A Level courses, minimum final grade of two B's and one C. English at either the GCSE, AS, or A Level, minimum final grade of B/5.
Passes in at least five unique subjects, three of which must be at the Advanced Level

ib.title: Honours Arts (includes 28 majors) admission requirements for International Baccalaureate (IB) high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: HL or SL English A - minimum 4 or HL English B - minimum 5; total 27
IB diploma required with six total IB courses; at least three must be HL.

us.title: Honours Arts (includes 28 majors) admission requirements for American (US) system high school students | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: Grade 12 English, minimum final grade of 75%. Minimum Grade 12 average of low 80s.

dl.title: Application deadlines | Undergraduate Programs | University of Waterloo
quotes: Programs other than Engineering February 1, 2027 February 15, 2027

admissions.threshold: Philosophy (Honours Arts, Faculty of Arts): three A-Levels with minimum final grades of two Bs and one C, and English at GCSE, AS or A-Level (minimum B/5); passes in five subjects, three at A-Level.
Philosophy (Honours Arts, Faculty of Arts): IB Diploma (six courses, at least three HL) with English A (HL or SL, minimum 4, or HL English B 5); total 27, excluding diploma points.
Philosophy (Honours Arts, Faculty of Arts): Grade 12 English (minimum 75%) and a Grade 12 average in the low 80s (no exact figure published).
